title: SDSS9 color
credit: Sloan Digital Sky Survey; color HiPS CDS/P/SDSS9/color by T. Boch (CDS), cut out by the CDS hips2fits service

geometryEvidence.reference: A picture of the sky, centred on the galaxy, so its plane faces the Sun. The recipe's inclination of 0.001° is not a measurement: the bake needs a plane with some depth along the sight line, and this is the smallest tilt that gives it one.

displayModel: The photograph lies on one flat plane facing the Sun at the galaxy's distance. Nothing in the image has depth: seen from the side it is a line.
coverage: Stars are removed from the picture before the bake by NOX, which predicts the light under a star and does not measure it; 8 of the 8 Gaia stars brighter than G 14 in the picture had a glow, filled out to at most 156 px (38″).

acquisition.operation: Request the cutout from the CDS hips2fits service: 3000 x 3000 px, 0.204 degrees wide, tangent projection on 169.732960, +13.092309, north up; no crop or resample.
